snippet.title: PLANETOIDS | ON Steam Game
snippet.description:
PLANETOIDS is a 2D hand-drawn game that is a retro space arcade game. In it you have to shoot and dodge meteors, comets and wandering planets in outer space. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090630/PLANETOIDS/
